title: Cogwheels and Wires
description: Little Create-centered modpack! Create and addon integrations for other mods and more!
body:
Create-centered modpack I made for playing with friends.
Consists mainly from Create Mod addons. Main ones being [Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) and [Power Grid](https://modrinth.com/mod/power-grid).

Modpacks goal is to integrate fun crafting methods from Create and realistic and detailed electricity system from Power Grid into Minecraft in pleasant way.

Modpack includes:
- Custom minecraft and modded recipes for better Create mod integration
- Recipe Viewer clean up (tag groups, hidden chiseled blocks etc.)
- Default mod configs
- Power Grid is the only source of electricity!

![Custom smithing templates recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4de90d5dbc55f072aa27fe407d81cbd7364c2ed4_0.webp) ![Custom Sophisticated Backpack recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d56d4dd65dc637511dfaf30507bd001bd1600c72_0.webp)

Worldgen is powered by Terralith and Tectonic.


Planned features:
- Quests!
- Custom main menu and panorama (with FancyMenu)
- Custom GUIs (for mod config menus and such) for less cluttered keybinds
